bio: Treat yourself to Afternoon Tea at Guildford Manor Hotel, a charming country house hotel overlooking the picturesque Surrey Hills.  Surrounded by acres of parkland and gardens, Guildford Manor Hotel boasts breathtaking views of remarkable natural beauty. Enjoy a traditional Afternoon Tea in the contemporary setting of Newlands Corner Restaurant with a backdrop of the surrounding countryside.  Served on lavish three-tiered cake stands, Afternoon Tea at Guildford Manor Hotel is always a delicious affair. Indulge in a selection of dainty finger sandwiches, freshly baked plain and raisin scones and a decadent array of mini cakes and pastries. All of this is served alongside your choice of tea, supplied by the world renowned boutique tea house, T2.  Guildford Manor Hotel is situated just 3 miles from Guildford city centre and a 40-minute drive from London.
